commands.author: yangpanxydt

target.title: fix(gateway): return structured capability error when node lacks exec approvals
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw approvals get --node <node-id> --json` currently fails with a raw JavaScript TypeError when the selected node does not advertise the exec approvals capability.

Observed output:

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'socket')
```

## Why This Change Was Made

Check the node's declared commands before invoking. Previously the check used `node.commands` (the filtered effective surface), which could drop `system.execApprovals.get/set` even for capable nodes during gateway command reconciliation. Now uses `node.declaredCommands` (the raw advertised capability list).

## Changes

- Add capability preflight in `respondWithExecApprovalsNodePayload`: reject before invoking if the node does not advertise the requested command
- Use `node.declaredCommands` instead of `node.commands` to avoid false rejections from command reconciliation
- Remove early disconnected-node return so missing nodes fall through to `nodeRegistry.invoke` for proper NOT_CONNECTED error details
- Add 4 tests covering get/set accept/reject scenarios

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Return structured UNAVAILABLE error instead of raw TypeError when node lacks exec approvals capability.
**Environment tested:** Node 22.x on Linux, \`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs\`
**Steps run after the patch:** Ran targeted unit tests
**Evidence after fix:**

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/exec-approvals.test.ts --reporter verbose

 ✓ returns a structured unavailable error when local approvals get cannot read state
 ✓ returns a structured unavailable error when local approvals set cannot persist
 ✓ rejects node exec approvals get when the node lacks the capability
 ✓ accepts node exec approvals get when the node advertises the capability
 ✓ accepts node exec approvals set when the node advertises the capability
 ✓ rejects node exec approvals set when the node lacks the capability

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

**Observed result:** All 6 tests pass. New tests verify that:
- Node without \`system.execApprovals.get\` returns UNAVAILABLE with descriptive message
- Node with the capability proceeds to \`nodeRegistry.invoke\`
- Both get and set handlers are covered

**Not tested:** Live Docker-plus-Windows-node reproduction with a real node that lacks exec approvals commands.

Fixes #97578
